name: Hutka — karting telemetry
subtitle: Every corner of your kart lap
promotionalText: Upload your lap timer file — or record straight from the kart with the phone on the wheel — and see where every corner loses time.
description:
Hutka is racing AI for karting. Upload a session from your lap timer — or record one straight from the kart with your phone on the wheel — and see where your lap loses time, corner by corner, compared with your own fastest passes and with the fastest drivers on the same layout.

WHAT YOU GET
• Every corner, in numbers: braking point, release, apex speed, throttle point and exit speed — for your best lap and for the fastest passes through that corner.
• The reserve per corner: how many tenths each corner leaves on the table, and which three corners matter most.
• Best vs ideal: the ideal lap stitched from your fastest pass through every corner, and the breakdown that shows which lap won each corner.
• Three laps on one map: your best, a friend's and any other lap side by side, with every driver's braking points.
• Replay: press play and the karts run the lap in real time — the faster one pulls ahead.
• Your GPS line on the satellite picture of the track.
• An AI coach that has read your telemetry and answers in plain words: "where do I lose the most?", "what should I change in T7?"
• Sport karts too: revs, gear bands, every upshift and downshift on the map (Alfano 6, Rotax DD2, KZ).
• Track pages with corner guides and the fastest published laps; a track that is not in Hutka yet gets its own page from your session.
• Record from kart: no lap timer? Put the phone on the wheel mount — it times your laps with its own GPS, shows the last and the best lap, the delta to your best, and the session goes straight into the Lab.
• From the lap timer over Bluetooth: read the sessions out of an Alfano 7 or a RaceBox without the vendor's app.

WORKS WITH
Alfano (ALF2), AiM, RaceChrono, TrackAddict, VBOX, GPX — one file per session, exported from your logger app — plus the phone's own GPS.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Export the session from your lap timer app, read it over Bluetooth, or record it from the kart.
2. Upload it — the track and the layout are recognised by GPS.
3. See every corner, compare with the fastest, ask the coach.

Rental karting and sport karting, any track in the world. Browsing tracks and published sessions is free and open to everyone; sign in to upload your own sessions and keep your library across devices.
whatsNew: Hutka on the App Store: the karting Lab, the AI coach, sessions from the lap timer over Bluetooth, and Record from kart — the phone on the wheel as your lap timer.

review.notes:
Hutka analyses go-kart telemetry (GPS logs from lap timers such as Alfano) and shows where a lap loses time corner by corner.

DEMO ACCOUNT: sign in with the e-mail and password given above (demo account). On the sign-in screen tap "Continue with email", then "I have a password" (the default is a 6-digit code sent by e-mail). The demo account already has two sample sessions from Dubai Kartdrome: open Lab → My sessions → "Demo · Ironman 14 Oct 2026". There you will see the lap on the satellite picture, every corner's numbers, "Compare" (best vs ideal, other drivers), the replay, and the Hutka AI tab answers questions about the session.

Browsing tracks and published sessions works without an account.

FEATURES THAT NEED HARDWARE: "From the lap timer" reads an Alfano 7 / RaceBox over Bluetooth (a physical lap timer is required); "Record from kart" uses the phone's GPS while driving — it can be tried by walking or driving around any loop, the lap times appear live. Both are optional; the file upload and the demo sessions show the whole analysis.

Sign-in options: Sign in with Apple, Google, e-mail (6-digit code) and e-mail + password.

The app shows the live web app (hutka.ai) in a native shell with native sharing, push notifications, file open-in ("Open in Hutka" for .alf2 / .gpx files), Bluetooth for lap timers and GPS recording.
